scope: Only experience thresholds and experience-to-level lookup. No stats, skill learning, inventory, save, battle or whole-file approval.
review: LEVEL_CAP=30; level 1 maps to 0; above-cap levels recurse to cap; .75 formula truncates; xp lookup compares next threshold inclusively. Supported level input >=1, signed int32 experience. Invalid nonpositive levels are rejected by native API; upstream formula outside game level domain is not supported.
reference: Godot 3.6.2 executes unchanged copies of the two audited functions with their unchanged LEVEL_CAP constant in an isolated Reference script; not a full original-game run. No reference output is fabricated.
